'''Star Tours Flight 1112''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1E at 1550 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1645.
